title: Aureline M5 restart-consequence-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the restart_consequence_card family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A restart consequence card names which restart / interrupt action it describes and what survives it so a card never leaves restart / reconnect consequences or preserved-versus-lost state implicit. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
